verdict: Lead volume collapsed this week; heating season response is underway now.
narrative: This period delivered 17 leads at a cost of $99.14 each, but the last seven days tell a harder story: leads dropped 92% versus the prior seven days, and the last three days of the window produced zero leads on active spend. Google Ads pulled back 34% week-over-week and Meta's creative appears to have fatigued, leaving recent results near zero despite dollars going out the door. Heating campaigns and fall creative are being activated now to reverse this before the season peaks. Google Business Profile optimization is also in motion on two profiles running well below their call-rate potential, which should recover organic volume without added spend.
